$ rea inspect-byte-entropy --llms --llms-full
exit: 0
--- stdout
# rea inspect-byte-entropy

Inspect file-wide and block byte entropy without executing the file

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `path` | `string` | yes | Local file |

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--block-size` | `unknown` | `4096` | Power-of-two block size from 256 to 65536 bytes |
| `--offset` | `unknown` | `0` | Window start as a decimal file byte offset |
| `--length` | `unknown` |  | Window length in bytes; omit to extend through EOF |
| `--detail` | `string` |  | Omit for complete Evidence when it fits the agent result budget (32768 compact JSON bytes by default, about 11k tokens) and its summary otherwise; complete always delivers everything; summary needs --evidence_output |
| `--evidence_output` | `string` |  | Save complete Evidence as a bundle; required for summary delivery. Never overwrites. |
<end>

<end>
